content.comment_body: Is there a straightforward way to send an output signal from one [product_name] [article_no] unit to the input of another [article_no]? I've tried directly wiring via a shared PSU, but no success so far. I also attempted Network I/O, but I'm not sure I configured it properly. My goal is to use a second module as a totalizer in a counting system, where the program registers pulses and tallies one count every 70 pulses. The counting works, but the totalizer doesn't receive the output from the first device. Any advice would be appreciated.
Please refer to the attached file.

Thank you for your prompt reply. I managed to set up a solution similar to your PNG example, although I don't see the NI or NQ options in the dropdown menus. Nevertheless, my system is now working. Thanks again!

analysis.insight_summary: Users are searching for a simple way to establish communication between two [product_name] modules ([article_no] version), focusing on transferring output data for counting and totalizing tasks. The primary usability challenges are the clarity and discoverability of network I/O setup, and the visibility of configuration options like NI or NQ within the software interface.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope for a clear, straightforward process to connect one module's output to another's input, including easy-to-follow configuration instructions and interface guidance when setting up Network I/O.
